verdict.rationale: TWC documents its own batch channel: QuickFile, a free installable tool that reports wage data for over 1,000 employees directly from a formatted file, alongside the UTS online system. This is file-based bulk submission, not a documented system-to-system channel, and no OpenAPI spec was found at any probed path. missing for 10: a documented machine API or system-account mechanism, a published transmitter/batch-provider enrollment path, the file format specification, and independent corroboration.
